themes.name: I Love You — For Him
themes.description: A little something to remind him how much he means to you.
themes.visualDirection: Thoughtful, romantic, elegant packaging and a personalised note.
themes.heroStory: Thoughtful gifts and personal touches to show him how much he is appreciated. Choose your budget, write your personal message, and let us help prepare a hamper made with care.
giftingTips: Pair with a photograph from a favourite shared memory
Add your personal message or inside joke to be handwritten on the card
Coordinate with our team on WhatsApp for convenient delivery
themes.comingSoonMessage: Something special for him is on its way. Stay tuned!

themes.name: I Love You — For Her
themes.description: Little surprises, thoughtful details, and a whole lot of love.
themes.visualDirection: Romantic, aesthetic packaging and a personal message.
themes.heroHeadline: Thoughtful gifts and sweet gestures for her
themes.heroStory: Thoughtful gifts and personal touches for someone who means the world to you. Choose your budget, share your message, and let us help create a hamper made with care.
giftingTips: Write a heartfelt message to be handwritten on a card
Add optional sweet treats or flowers to make it extra special
Tell us her favourite colours or details so we can match the styling

themes.name: Anniversary Box
themes.description: Celebrate your story, one little memory at a time.
themes.visualDirection: Elegant keepsakes, personalised messages, and romantic packaging.
themes.heroHeadline: Celebrate your milestones and the memories you have built together
themes.heroStory: Whether celebrating months or years of shared memories around CU and Mohali, our Anniversary Box helps you mark your journey with thoughtful surprises and a heartfelt handwritten card.
giftingTips: Mention your relationship milestone date or inside memories in your note
Add optional photo memories or sweet treats to commemorate the day
Coordinate delivery timing with our team for a seamless surprise

themes.name: Birthday Box
themes.description: Make their special day feel even more special.
themes.visualDirection: Festive packaging, cheerful accents, and birthday cards.
themes.heroHeadline: Celebrate their birthday with sweet warmth and personal flair
themes.heroStory: Make campus birthdays and hostel surprises memorable. Curated with celebratory touches, sweet treats, and a personal birthday message handwritten for them.
giftingTips: Schedule delivery for morning or afternoon hostel gate handover
Add a personal birthday wish with their nickname or favourite memories
Select their favourite treats or cute add-ons

themes.name: Periods Box
themes.description: A little extra care for the days that call for it.
themes.visualDirection: A supportive comfort-care package with thoughtful notes, snacks, and optional period-care essentials. Keep the presentation tasteful and non-stigmatising. Only list items whose availability has been confirmed.
themes.heroHeadline: Warmth, comfort, and gentle care when she needs it most
themes.heroStory: A supportive, comforting care package for days that call for extra gentleness. Curated with comforting snacks, thoughtful touches, and a warm handwritten card to remind her she is cared for.
giftingTips: Include soothing snacks or treats she enjoys
Keep the card message warm, supportive, and gentle
Specify hostel or PG gate delivery timing for convenience

themes.name: Apology Box
themes.description: Sometimes, a thoughtful gesture says what words struggle to.
themes.visualDirection: Heartfelt message cards, thoughtful keepsakes, and understated packaging. Do not suggest that a gift guarantees forgiveness or fixes a relationship.
themes.heroHeadline: A sincere, heartfelt gesture when words fall short
themes.heroStory: Saying sorry takes honesty and quiet sincerity. An understated, thoughtful hamper with a personal handwritten card where you can speak from the heart.
giftingTips: Speak honestly in your handwritten card without pressure
Keep the presentation understated and sincere
Let the quiet gesture show that you care

themes.name: Miss You Box
themes.description: For the people you wish were a little closer.
themes.visualDirection: Personal letters, memory cards, keepsakes, and thoughtful packaging.
themes.heroHeadline: Thoughtful surprises for someone you miss
themes.heroStory: Whether studying away at Chandigarh University or missing someone in another city, distance feels softer with a thoughtful surprise and a personal handwritten card.
giftingTips: Include a favourite memory or photo from your last visit
Write a warm note about looking forward to meeting next
Coordinate delivery directly to their hostel or PG address

themes.name: Valentine Box
themes.description: A little romance, wrapped just for them.
themes.visualDirection: Romantic gift presentation, coordinated packaging, and personalised messages.
themes.heroHeadline: Sweet feelings and thoughtful romance, wrapped just for them
themes.heroStory: A classic, romantic gesture for someone special. Curated with sweet treats, romantic touches, and a heartfelt handwritten card to celebrate your feelings.
giftingTips: Pair with our Loved Box (Medium — ₹969) for a complete romantic gesture
Add a sweet love note to be handwritten on the card
Reserve your delivery date in advance for Valentine season

themes.name: Diwali Box
themes.description: Celebrate the festival of lights with thoughtful surprises.
themes.visualDirection: Festive gift packaging, warm golden accents, greeting cards, and suitable sweets or keepsakes where available.
themes.heroHeadline: Celebrate the festival of lights with warmth and joy
themes.heroStory: Bring festive warmth to student hostels and family homes. Curated with festive packaging, sweet treats, and a warm festive greeting card to celebrate Diwali.
giftingTips: Include warm festive wishes for friends, roommates, or loved ones
Add sweet treats or festive touches
Coordinate early hostel deliveries ahead of festive holidays
